description: This PHP class provides utility functions for web service interactions and URL encoding, including fetching data from a web URL and encoding text for URL transmission within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: Service
classes.description: Provides static methods for interacting with web services and encoding URLs within the PhpSpreadsheet calculation Web namespace.

methods.name: webService
methods.description: Fetches data from a specified web URL using GET method, handling errors and response validation.

methods.name: urlEncode
methods.description: Encodes a string for safe inclusion in URL queries, replacing '+' with '%20'.
